attempts.summary: Node1 now publishes the approved boot tree as a persistent, read-only TFTP root. Node2 successfully downloads boot.cfg and firmware.bin with byte-identical hashes. Uploads, overwrites, and requests outside the boot root are rejected. Both nodes retained RHEL 9.8 and kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8 and passed sequential restart/recovery verification.
